description: ManageCA / ManageCertificates rights on the CA, enabling the operator to enable ESC6 or approve their own requests.

telemetry.detail: Logon to the CA context to exercise management rights.
Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA).
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
Toggling the EDITF SAN flag or approving pending requests are CA-management actions that mature monitoring flags.

prerequisite_privilege: ManageCA or ManageCertificates on the enterprise CA
abuse_primitive: Enable EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 (-> ESC6) or approve a held malicious request.
notes: A capability edge: it enables ESC6-style abuse. The configuration change to the CA is the loud, high-fidelity moment.
